skillsSection.workStyleSubtitle: Disciplined workflow honed through 3+ years of working directly with Japanese clients:

workStyleItems.title: Clear Requirements & Proactive Communication
workStyleItems.description: Thoroughly analyze specifications, proactively ask clarifying questions when needed, and align on technical edge cases before writing code.

workStyleItems.title: Commitment to Highest Quality
workStyleItems.description: Deliver clean, maintainable, and type-safe code with high attention to UI/UX polish and performance across Web and Mobile platforms.

workStyleItems.title: Comprehensive Test Cases & Self-Testing
workStyleItems.description: Carefully design and execute test cases covering happy paths, edge cases, and cross-platform behavior (iOS, Android & Responsive Web) prior to handover.

items.name: Swipe Drama
items.highlightBadge: Short Drama Platform • Web + iOS + Android
items.description: Swipe Drama is a TikTok-style short drama app where users can swipe through episodes, discover featured content, earn coins from tasks, and use them to unlock premium episodes.
responsibilities: Fixed bugs and improved mobile app stability across production releases.
Refactored code for better maintainability and smoother video streaming performance.
Tested features and resolved technical & functional issues.
Developed and delivered new features across mobile and web/backend.
Investigated and fixed platform-specific issues on both iOS and Android.

items.name: DigDig — Second-hand Fashion Marketplace
items.highlightBadge: End-to-End Ownership • Japanese Marketplace • Web + iOS + Android
items.description: DigDig is a second-hand fashion marketplace connecting sellers and customers to buy and sell pre-owned clothing. Directly received tasks from Japanese clients and owned features end-to-end across Web/Shopify, Backend APIs, and Mobile Apps.
responsibilities: Received tasks directly from Japanese clients and delivered features end-to-end — from requirement clarification and DB/API design to web storefront and mobile app releases.
Developed and customized Shopify e-commerce stores with responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
Built custom Shopify themes and features using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrated Shopify APIs and webhooks for product synchronization, inventory updates, stock levels, and pricing.
Developed a mobile e-commerce application for iOS and Android, supporting product browsing, ordering, and payment processing.

items.name: Trudi® AI — Property Management Platform
items.highlightBadge: Enterprise PropTech • Team Size: 100 • AWS & ChatGPT
items.description: Trudi® integrates with your property management software, so you can handle all incoming enquiries and tasks from one centralised platform.
responsibilities: Designed and developed custom UI components in React Native and Angular, ensuring consistent design across mobile and web.
Collaborated with backend developers in a 100-member team to define API requirements and integrate RESTful APIs for seamless data communication.
Fixed bugs and developed new features across web and mobile applications.

items.name: VRI Portal — 911 Interpreters
items.highlightBadge: Healthcare Interpretation • Twilio Video/Audio • Web & App
items.description: Interpretation management software between patients and interpreters in the hospital through video and audio calls on the web or mobile app.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained the mobile application using React Native, ensuring cross-platform compatibility for both iOS and Android.
Created intuitive user interfaces tailored for mobile devices in hospital environments.
Created real-time audio and video call interfaces using Twilio.
